name: Brandenburg Gate
description: Berlin’s neoclassical gate crowns Pariser Platz. The quadriga faces east along Unter den Linden.

name: Cologne Cathedral
description: Twin Gothic spires dominate the Rhine skyline beside the main station. Climb for a view over the river.

name: Neuschwanstein Castle
description: Ludwig II’s fairy-tale castle rises above Alpine foothills. Tickets are timed; the gorge bridge gives the classic view.

name: Reichstag Building
description: Germany’s parliament building is topped by a glass dome open to visitors with registration.

name: Zwinger
description: Baroque courtyards and galleries form Dresden’s famous palace complex beside the Elbe.

name: Museum Island
description: A cluster of museums fills an island in the Spree, including the Pergamon (with ongoing renovations).

name: Englischer Garten
description: A vast city park with beer gardens, a Chinese tower and a riverside surfing wave.

name: Heidelberg Castle
description: Ruined red-sandstone terraces overlook the Neckar old town. Gardens and viewpoints surround the courtyards.

name: Rhine Gorge viewpoints
description: Castles and vineyards line the Middle Rhine. Boat decks and hillside trails share the valley views.

name: Speicherstadt
description: Red-brick warehouse canals form a UNESCO harbour district with museums and footbridges.

name: Markthalle Neun
description: A Kreuzberg market hall hosts street-food Thursday and weekday produce stalls.

name: Viktualienmarkt
description: Munich’s open-air food market surrounds a beer garden with cheese, sausage and flower stalls.

name: Kleinmarkthalle
description: Frankfurt’s indoor market sells produce, sausages and seated snacks in the city centre.

name: Nuremberg Hauptmarkt
description: The main market square is known for gingerbread, sausages and seasonal stalls beneath the Frauenkirche.

name: Hamburg Fish Market
description: Sunday morning fish auctions and stalls draw early crowds by the Elbe.

name: Oktoberfest
description: Munich’s autumn beer festival fills Theresienwiese with tents, rides and traditional dress.
